summary_en: 42% stake in Franchise Business Incubation K.K. acquired for undisclosed consideration via settlement of shareholder dispute. AI Fusion Capital's ownership rises from 58% to 100%, making FBI a wholly owned subsidiary, effective 2026-08-10.
title_en: Notice regarding settlement of stock acquisition-related dispute concerning Franchise Business Incubation K.K. and achievement of wholly owned subsidiary status
translation_en_brief: AI Fusion Capital Group has settled a shareholder dispute concerning Franchise Business Incubation K.K. (FBI) and completed acquisition of the remaining stake for 100% ownership. In April 2026, AI Fusion had acquired 58% of FBI from one shareholder. A separate group of shareholders (Naoki Hayasaka, N&S Partners Co., Ltd., Hideyuki Kato, and Mitsushige Ito, collectively holding 42%) then filed for a preliminary injunction against the transferring shareholder to block the share sale. On 10 August 2026, all parties reached settlement. As part of the settlement, AI Fusion agreed to acquire the remaining 42% stake held by the four shareholders for undisclosed consideration. FBI is now 100%-owned as of 10 August 2026. The settlement includes confidentiality provisions; acquisition price and other details are not disclosed. The consolidation will affect the attribution of earnings to non-controlling interests and the parent company owner.
